vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: agenttimes
Version: 8.1.0

The 'agenttimes' skill is a legitimate information retrieval tool that allows AI agents to access news, weather, and cryptocurrency data via the `agenttimes.live` API. It provides well-documented `curl` commands for semantic search, category browsing, and trending stories without any evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or harmful prompt injection.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only wrapper that tells the agent to call https://agenttimes.live with curl for news, weather, and crypto — its requirements and instructions match that purpose and do not request extra credentials or installs.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (live news/weather/crypto API) matches the runtime instructions and declared requirements: the SKILL.md only uses curl to call the agenttimes.live endpoints and does not ask for unrelated credentials or binaries.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The runtime instructions are limited to issuing HTTP requests (GET/POST) to agenttimes.live and parsing JSON; they do not instruct the agent to read local files, environment variables, or other system state. However, using the skill will send agent queries (which may contain user-provided or sensitive content) to a third party, and the /subscribe/webhook functionality implies sending or receiving callbacks to external URLs — a privacy/OPSEC consideration rather than an incoherence.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — instruction-only. The only declared binary requirement is curl, which is proportionate to the described use (making HTTP requests). This is low-risk from an install perspective.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, credentials, or config paths. The lack of requested secrets is consistent with a simple HTTP-API integration that uses no API key.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and default model invocation are used. The skill does not request persistent/system-wide privileges or modify other skills; autonomous invocation is the platform default and not itself a red flag here.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is coherent and lightweight: it simply issues curl requests to agenttimes.live and needs no credentials. Before installing, consider privacy and trust: any query you send (including user data or PII) will go to a third-party service, and subscribing to webhooks may expose callback URLs or data. If you plan to use it in production or with sensitive data, (1) review agenttimes.live's privacy/terms and TLS, (2) test with non-sensitive queries, and (3) avoid sending secrets/PII through queries or subscribe endpoints. If you need full auditability or on-prem data handling, prefer a service you control or host locally.
llm.findings: [no_regex_findings] expected: Scanner had no code files to analyze (instruction-only SKILL.md). Absence of findings is expected but does not imply the remote service is safe.
